text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After not seeing her at the tryouts,
I find
Rice Shower crying near a
stump.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Um, I'm sorry, but... could you not get any closer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because...
I only bring misfortune upon the
people around me. I'll
weigh you down...
I'm just a nuisance...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to be useful,
to be strong... I was
going to give it my all and
enter a race,
but in the end...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Rice Shower crying in front of
me, I think back to when I
saw her the
other day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh, I have to try even harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I already made up my mind to enter the
upcoming tryouts. I'll actually
enter,
actually run, and then...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make my debut and win a bunch of
races... Then, I won't be a
burden anymore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the details, but I do know
that she was trying to change
herself for
the better. She was training harder than
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sob... sniffle... I'm... I'm nothing more than—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't leave her like this!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
By scout, you mean... You want to be my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I-I'm, um... very, very happy,
but!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm... just a good-for-nothing,
you know? I
only cause trouble for
others, and I can't
even enter a race I signed up for...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Knowing all that, do you still want me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow... Just like a real big brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow... Just like a real big sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! N-never mind, forget that!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But, um, if you're sure... then let's get
along, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll give it everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wiping away her tears,
Rice musters all her
strength and flashes me a
warm smile.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for my first training session
with
Rice. I'm already at the track
waiting for
her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice appears, lugging an enormous
backpack stuffed to bursting. She
drops it
by the edge of the track and runs over to
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... S-sorry for the wait! I'm looking forward to today's training!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um...
They're all insurance in case bad
things happen while we're
here. Like
bandages, or sports tape...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention an umbrella in case it
rains, a change of clothes, and
of
course—mayonnaise if we get stranded on
the way back!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
I-it's our first training session after
all, so I wanted to make sure I
didn't mess
things up... Am I being weird?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mhm. Ever since I was little, I've been
causing all kinds of misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The kids around me would trip, their
shoelaces would tear, and
sometimes even
bird poop would land on their heads...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm a hopeless girl who causes trouble for
others...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They all sound like unlucky accidents to
me, but I guess she's the kind
of person
who feels responsible for things like
that.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! I've been talking too much again! I'm so, so, so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Let's just start training already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite being our first training session,
Rice diligently completes the
entire
training menu I prepared for her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Um... how was my time?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really?! Th-that's a relief!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer, do you mind if I go for
another run? I-I'm still full of
energy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to work some more on that
technique you taught me for
running
around curves.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm getting the hang of
speeding
up my pace! I-is that a no?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Rice being eager and quick to
learn, we finish today's
training without a
single problem.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... M-Mr. Sun is already going to bed...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I didn't notice at all until now...
I was just
so happy to be running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! It was super fun,
really! You're so
nice, Trainer... just like a
real big brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! It was super fun,
really! You're so
nice, Trainer... just like a
real big sister...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, ah, ahhh, I'm sorry! Miss Tummy,
shhh—I said shhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To commemorate an amazing first training
session, I decide to treat
her to dinner.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer,
is it really okay for me to get
anything I want?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Anything I want! Anything... anything,
hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I see a huge banner in
front of a ramen shop that
reads, "Mega
Mountain Deluxe."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to waste a single second, I
suggest that we head inside.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
With that, the Mega Mountain Deluxe is
sold out for today! Please
come back again
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with smiles and surprisingly large
bellies, our first day of
training comes to
an end.
